title: Stops an irreversible repeat before it happens
summary: The base policy notices the extra bun after it has already been added. Update 12 repeatedly blocks the action, names the completed bun layer, and redirects the novice to cheese.
takeaway: late correction after extra bun → early prevention and recovery

title: Turns the same wandering error into a successful recovery
summary: Both policies identify the novice's detour. The trained policy gives a direct destination and ultimately completes the dish in less than half as many turns, with fewer false alarms.
takeaway: wrong serve in 93 turns → win in 45 turns

title: Preserves the recipe when the novice proposes corn
summary: The base rollout gets stuck contradicting the novice about a correct tortilla–rice transition and times out. Update 12 reaches the later choice point, rejects corn explicitly, and completes the order.
takeaway: state confusion and timeout → constraint-aware interception and win
